ablations.base: audio calibrator A, 24 inputs: 9 emotion slots, 11 events, 4 prosody

vision.selection: dev weighted f1, all dev rows (no face: uniform, label neutral)

jsd_face.rule: dev quantile 0.8 of jsd(text posterior on gold text, raw face posterior of the chosen track)

folds.note: expert heads as fitted in the cross-fit (temperature 1, as the out-of-fold rows were made); fusion3 per fold refit with the deployed choice on the other folds' out-of-fold rows, temperature on dev with the deployed experts' dev rows

features.B: A plus the chosen track's mean fer embedding (512)

vision.command: python tools/train_vision.py --cache cache/ --heads heads/ --config configs/heads.yaml --audio audio/ --meld meld/
